business_problem: China Mobile Guangdong wanted to upgrade enterprise support operations so account managers could handle enterprise services faster, reduce repetitive preparation work, and improve customer experience under its AI+ strategy.
solution_summary: China Mobile Guangdong and Huawei built the "AI+BOSS" program around an "AI Account Manager Assistant" that serves as a dedicated AI partner for each account manager. Huawei's self-developed LLM Engine provides the underlying data and model foundation, explicitly supporting data collection, model training, and service deployment so the assistant can run on a unified, secure platform with second-level interface switching and zero data leakage claims. On top of that platform, Huawei applied its AI-Native architecture to deliver intent recognition, intelligent agent orchestration, and autonomous AI decision-making for telecom-specific workflows. A joint expert team from Huawei and China Mobile Guangdong continuously refined the models and prompts, then pushed changes through agile delivery and continuous integration from prototype validation to commercial deployment. Huawei also added self-learning feedback loops and KPI-based evaluation so the assistant keeps improving after launch while maintaining carrier-grade reliability at scale.
